title: Production readiness checklist for AI-built apps, with measured research on 53 public repositories
description:
A launch checklist for applications built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Replit or Claude Code, with each item triaged by whether it blocks a launch and by whether it can be checked automatically or needs human judgement.

Accompanied by a static analysis of 53 public repositories that declare the AI tool they were built with, reporting rates per failure category with 95% confidence intervals, and reporting the measured precision and recall of the scanner that produced them.

Write-up with every table: nicchin.com/blog/vibe-coded-app-security-study.
